name: rolling-number
title: Rolling Number
description: Odometer where every place rolls at its own speed, new places rising into view, settling exactly on the target value.
useWhen: Animating a large integer metric on a stats or milestone slide (revenue, signups, impressions).
Each digit place should animate independently so the viewer can read the number building up.
The from and to values are pure numbers with no currency symbol or unit.
avoidWhen: The value has a prefix or suffix like $99 or 1.2M: use slot-machine-roll.
The change is small or decorative and wants a playful reel feel.
The value is a small integer or counts down: use number-wheel.
author: Remocn
